title: The follow-up claim and its result

kind.description: record for the marker's kind in the records registry, run for a value of its run field, and <run>-outcome (tick-outcome, manual-outcome) for a value of the outcome field of that run's marker.

name.description: The record kind's registered name, or the value as the marker's field carries it.

run.description: For an outcome, the run whose marker carries it; null for the record and the runs.

markers.description: For the record, its hidden markers, each as written after `<!-- `, separated by a comma and a space; null otherwise.

version.description: For the record, the version Jig's writers write now, which its envelope's v carries; null otherwise.

key.description: For the record, the whole shape of its envelope's key as a regular expression; null otherwise.

meaning.description: What it means to a reader that meets it, and what that reader does with it.

values.name: dispatch-followup
values.meaning: The claim on a merged pull request's one follow-up: which run took it, a dispatcher's tick or a person's, and once it ended, its outcome. A follow-up posts or reads it before it acts, and stops when an earlier trusted marker holds the follow-up.

values.name: tick
values.meaning: A dispatcher's tick took the follow-up: its marker names the launch record of the session the tick started and the host that started it, and that host writes the follow-up's outcome onto the marker once the launch record ends.

values.name: manual
values.meaning: A person ran the follow-up, and its run posted the marker through `jig dispatch marker claim`: the run writes its own outcome onto it (`jig dispatch marker done`).

values.name: done
values.meaning: The follow-up's session recorded its result as done (`jig dispatch result`): the follow-up is finished, and nothing starts it again.

values.name: failed
values.meaning: The follow-up's session ended without recording done, or its launch died and is not retried: a person acts, and the marker keeps holding the follow-up against every later one until a person marks it done or deletes it.

values.name: running
values.meaning: A person's run claimed the follow-up and has not finished its last act. It holds the follow-up against every later run; a run that failed leaves it so (`jig dispatch marker failed`) until a person marks it done or deletes it.

values.name: done
values.meaning: A person's run finished its last act (`jig dispatch marker done`): the follow-up is finished.
